statement: At the pinned Linux kernel revision, the Microsoft HID driver explicitly matches Xbox Series model 1914 over Bluetooth as vendor 0x045e, product 0x0b13 and supplies conventional two-main-motor memoryless force feedback; generic HID remains a fallback for otherwise unmatched identities. A physical device's actual binding order and descriptor parsing success are not observed.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.scope: hid-microsoft.c:275-350, 427-435; hid-ids.h:1056-1060; hid-generic.c:82-90. Driver selection requires bus identity, registered modules and successful probe.
